title: One round of the window loop
statement: Let $k,K$ be nonnegative integers, let $Q,T,P_t,P_s$ be types, let $M$ be a $k$-tape Turing machine on Boolean symbols, and let $R_t$ and $R_s$ be Turing machines on record symbols with respectively one and $K+1$ work tapes and state types $P_t$ and $P_s$. Choose states $t_e,t_y,t_n\in P_t$ and $s_e,s_y,s_n\in P_s$ with $t_y\ne t_n$ and $s_y\ne s_n$, and natural numbers $C_t,C_s$. Given a Boolean input word $x$, a window radius $s$, a configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, a tag $\tau\in T$, and a configuration $d$ of the loop machine on the encoded input whose state is the anchor state, suppose the test machine, started at state $t_e$ on the record tape selected from $d$, has a run of length at most $C_t(L+1)$ that avoids states $t_y,t_n$ at every earlier time, moves its head by at most $C_t(L+1)$ from the initial tape-$0$ head position, and ends in state $t_y$ if $c$ is halted and in state $t_n$ otherwise. Here $L$ is the length of the joined fields of the record of $(s,c,\tau)$. Suppose also that the step machine, started from $d$ at state $s_e$, has a run of length at most $C_s(L+|x|+1)$ that avoids states $s_y,s_n$ at every earlier time and moves each work head by at most $C_s(L+1)$ from its initial position. If the next configuration $M(c)$ lies within radius $s$, this run ends in state $s_y$ with tape $0$ replaced on the record interval by the record of $M(c)$ and the updated tag; if it does not, the run ends in state $s_n$ with the configuration otherwise unchanged. Then the loop machine has a segment of length $t$ with $1\le t\le(C_t+C_s+3)(\operatorname{recordLength}(k,|x|,s)+|x|+1)$, avoiding its stop states at all earlier times and keeping every work-head position within $(C_t+C_s+3)(\operatorname{recordLength}(k,|x|,s)+1)$ of its initial position through time $t$. Its endpoint is the halted stop state if $c$ is halted; otherwise it is the anchor state with the updated record when $M(c)$ lies within the window, and the left-exit stop state when it does not.
hypotheses_covered: $k,K$ are natural numbers and $Q,T,P_t,P_s$ are types
$M$ is a $k$-tape Boolean-symbol machine; $R_t,R_s$ have respectively one and $K+1$ record-symbol work tapes
$t_e,t_y,t_n$ and $s_e,s_y,s_n$ are states of the respective machines
$x$ is a Boolean input, $s$ is a natural window radius, $c$ is an $M$-configuration on $x$, and $\tau\in T$
$d$ is a loop-machine configuration on the encoded input in the anchor state
The test run exists with its stated length, earlier-state avoidance, head-displacement bound, and terminal verdict
The step run exists with its stated length, earlier-state avoidance, and displacement bound for every work head
The step endpoint is the patched next record and updated tag if the next configuration is in the window
The step endpoint is the failure state with the configuration unchanged if the next configuration is outside the window
caveat: The formal hypotheses bound the step machine's work-head displacement from the positions in $d$, but do not explicitly require that its work tapes other than tape 0 are blank. The statement therefore describes only the specified endpoint behavior and does not add that extra condition.
